name: Times cryptic crossword, Times Crosswords book 1 No 155

clue.text: Course picked up by detective

Horribly behind with tricky input, but finish off early
Devised series of games

Date extract
Deal, perhaps, going nowhere in particular
Metal (not lead) obtained in this form?
